programs.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
programs.desc: When the mission looks impossible, you call in special ops - and Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he takes you behind enemy lines to reveal the elite machines behind history's boldest operations, from the stealth helicopter that hunted Bin Laden, the silent WWII carbine that made British commandos ghosts, and an insect-sized recon drone giving troops eyes inside enemy strongholds. It's next-level tech for next-level, previously impossible missions.
